monitoringinterval.description: Time interval between two monitoring attempts (e.g., 10m, 5s).

mailchecktimeout.description: Time until mail must have arrived after sending for a positive outcome.

smtp_port_default.description: Default SMTP port to use for the first server entry.

smtp_login_default.description: Default login name on the SMTP server.

smtp_to_default.description: Default address to deliver monitoring mail to.

maildir_detection_dir_default.description: Default Maildir path in which to look for monitoring mail.

smtp_server_name_1.description: Name for the second server entry (used for internal Prometheus metrics).

smtp_server_host_1.description: Hostname of the second SMTP server.

smtp_port_1.description: Port of the second SMTP server.

smtp_login_1.description: Login name for the second SMTP server.

smtp_passphrase_1.description: Passphrase for the second SMTP server.

smtp_from_1.description: From-Header for mail sent via the second SMTP server.

smtp_to_1.description: To-Address for mail sent via the second SMTP server.

maildir_detection_dir_1.description: Maildir path for detecting mail from the second SMTP server.
